title: Вернём деньги клиентам (DELETE)
verify: SELECT 'order' AS tbl, id, person_id AS a, menu_id AS b FROM person_order UNION ALL SELECT 'menu', id, pizzeria_id, price FROM menu ORDER BY 1, 2

negative.why: обратный порядок: пицца не удаляется, пока на неё есть заказы (ошибка внешнего ключа)
negative.sql:
DELETE FROM menu WHERE pizza_name = 'greek pizza';
DELETE FROM person_order WHERE order_date = '2022-02-25';

negative.why: удалены не только новые заказы, а все
negative.sql:
DELETE FROM person_order;
DELETE FROM menu WHERE pizza_name = 'greek pizza';

negative.why: удалены заказы не за ту дату
negative.sql:
DELETE FROM person_order WHERE order_date = '2022-01-01';
DELETE FROM menu WHERE pizza_name = 'greek pizza';
